title: Golden-corpus calibration runbook and runtime shims for activation-aware INT8
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Goal: build an operational calibration and validation pipeline for activation-aware INT8 profiles (SmoothQuant style) that is gated by a curated golden corpus and supported by lightweight runtime kernel shims. This ticket covers the runbook for calibration data collection, profile generation, automated accuracy gating against FP16 baselines, and runtime engineering work to add a pluggable rescale shim in the CUDA microkernel path and a safe runtime fallback path for failing rollouts.
acceptance_criteria: Calibration pipeline produces per-layer and per-channel scale profiles that can be ingested by the serving runtime as a named profile
Golden-corpus regression tests detect quality regressions > 2% perplexity relative to FP16 baseline or embedding cosine similarity < 0.995 and mark the profile as rejected
Runtime exposes a feature flag 'enable_activation_rebalance' that toggles the rescale shim at request time without restarting nodes
Canary rollout template: 1% traffic for 24h, automated rollback if latency P95 increases > 25% or golden-corpus regression observed
End-to-end integration test that runs a KV-cache-heavy prompt set and verifies no OOM or KV corruption when rescale shim is active
steps: Define golden corpus: 3K prompts spanning short/long-context, instruction-following, code generation, and embedding pairs; produce FP16 baseline metrics
Instrument collector: run dataset through existing activation-telemetry harness to capture min/max and 2nd/99th percentiles for activations per layer and per head, using representative batch shapes
Profile generation: implement an offline transformer that computes per-channel scale factors using variance-ratio method; store as JSON profile with version and model-arch metadata

Validation harness: run deterministic evaluation comparing FP16 vs INT8(profile) on golden corpus; emit metrics (perplexity delta, token-level KL, embedding cosine distribution, instruction-quality microbenchmarks)
Runtime shim: add a small fused op that applies 'pre-matmul activation rescale' on activations according to loaded profile; implement CUDA kernel prototype + CPU fallback + unit tests
Rollout policy: implement canary percentage gating, telemetry alerts (quality and latency) and automatic rollback hook in console
Documentation: write calibration runbook and developer guide for generating profiles, with example CLI commands and a conformance checklist
notes: We intentionally separate profile generation from kernel changes so that profiles can be versioned and tested independently. Aim to keep shim minimal: pure rescale + optional transpose to align with existing matmul input layout. Avoid weight-side quant changes in this ticket.
comments: 2025-02-12 - Asha Kapoor: Initial triage. Scoped to calibration runbook, validation harness and a minimal runtime shim. Recommended the golden corpus be curated by PM and SRE to capture production traffic patterns.
2025-02-14 - Design review (Sofia Martin, PM): Add embedding similarity checks for search/semantic tasks. Suggest adding long-context (>8k) prompts to corpus because KV cache behavior differs.

2025-02-16 - Eng sync (Diego Alvarez): Prototype CUDA kernel runs at ~1.02x FP16 per-op latency on a 80B transformer layer when rescale is fused; memory overhead +3% in KV heavy sequences. Need microkernel tune to reduce overhead.

2025-02-18 - QA (Maya Singh): Validation harness shows two failing prompts with hallucination patterns when per-layer scale applied naively. Follow-up: implement small bias-correction pass in profile generator and rerun.

2025-02-20 - Liam Chen: Pushed initial PR with profile JSON schema and a shim skeleton. Requesting reviews from runtime and infra teams. Next: add automated golden-corpus CI job and canary rollout template in Console.
2025-02-21 - Notes from security review stub: No new secrets introduced. Ensure profile files are signed and versioned; gate load by org-tier in Dedicated/Private deployments.
